source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MailGlue overwrites isFlatpak/isSnap on every startup after packager defaults are applied. Non-Linux clears both. Linux checks environment-variable presence first and only falls back to lowercased default-branch distribution.id when neither flag was found. The two flags are not mutually exclusive. NotificationFilter reads Boolean preferences through its generic targeting lists; the new inputs do not themselves display a notification or prove an authenticated container state.
title: Package-targeting flags are recomputed after distribution defaults at startup
